page_title: LAZ 2-2 FIO | Lazio v Fiorentina 07/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) is booked.
90+5' 2 - 2 Goal! Pedro (Lazio) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for David de Gea to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
90+5' Pedro (Lazio) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is penalised for holding. Simone Sozza signals a set piece. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Lazio.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) replacing Fabiano Parisi.
90+2' Substitution. Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) in, Albert Gudmundsson out.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) duly receives a yellow card.
89' 1 - 2 Goal! Ivan Provedel gets a hand on the penalty from Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
89' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
88' The Fiorentina players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

86' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Fiorentina.
85' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
84' Fiorentina failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
83' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
80' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Manuel Lazzari limps off the pitch to be replaced by Elseid Hysaj (Lazio).
78' Looks like Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
74' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
72' Gustav Isaksen will be replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
71' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina).
68' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Cher Ndour is replaced by Manor Solomon (Fiorentina).
68' A pass by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) for Robin Gosens.
65' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
60' That's the end of the game for Roberto Piccoli, who is replaced by Moise Kean (Fiorentina).
60' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Ivan Provedel.
56' 1 - 1 Goal! Nicolo Fagioli sends a precise cross into the box, Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) latches on to it and puts the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
55' The referee shows a yellow card to Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
54' Referee Simone Sozza points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Lazio players celebrate.
53' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Lazio players aren’t happy.

52' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.

49' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Ivan Provedel leaps like a salmon to deny him.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Simone Sozza has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
41' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
36' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes.

33' That didn't go as planned! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past David de Gea, who easily kept it out.
30' Maurizio Sarri is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Toma Basic suffers an injury and Matias Vecino (Lazio) comes on.
26' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
24' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
22' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
21' Yellow card. Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
20' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
20' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Lazio players are visibly unhappy with the call.
20' Referee Simone Sozza makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lazio. Let’s see what happens!
19' PENALTY APPEAL after Mario Gila (Lazio) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
18' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
17' The resulting corner from Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
15' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) launches a cross from the corner, but David de Gea is alert to thwart the effort.
14' Toma Basic (Lazio) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
13' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Simone Sozza has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
9' Fiorentina enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
7' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) commits a rough foul. Simone Sozza stops the game and makes a call.
1' The resulting corner from Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is cleared by the defence.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Simone Sozza was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
